Envelope

Standard mailing envelopes, in assorted sizes, suitable for letters, invoices, recipient replies, donations, invitations, catalogs and brochures.

Select all options to see pricing.

Secure checkout · Powered by Shopify
Request a Quote Instead

Standard mailing envelopes in the sizes most businesses and organizations actually use — letters, invoices, reply envelopes, donation remits, invitations, and catalog-size documents. This is the general-purpose envelope order for anyone who needs professionally printed envelopes without a union print requirement.

Specifications

Sizes#10 Letter (4.125 x 9.5), #9 Reply (3.88 x 8.88), #6¾ Remit (3.63 x 6.5), A7 Greeting (5.25 x 7.25), 9 x 12 Document — each available in Color or Black & White printing
Ink / FinishColor or Black & White printing, selectable per size
Minimum Quantity250
Quantity Breaks250, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, 3000, 4000, 5000, 7500, 10000, 15000, 20000, 25000
Turnaround5–7 business days from proof approval

Common Use Cases

  • Letters and general business correspondence (#10)
  • Business reply envelopes for surveys and order forms (#9)
  • Donation and payment remit envelopes (#6¾)
  • Invitations and greeting card mailings (A7)
  • Catalogs, brochures, and documents that need to stay flat (9 x 12)

  1. 1 Choose your size and color option from the dropdown above

Frequently Asked Questions

What envelope sizes do you offer?

Five sizes: #10 Letter, #9 Reply, #6¾ Remit, A7 Greeting, and a 9 x 12 Document envelope. Each is available in Color or Black & White printing. See our full envelope sizes guide for USPS specs on each.

What's the difference between the Color and B&W options?

Both are the same envelope size and stock — the option simply determines whether your printed return address and any branding run in full color or black and white.

Can Cornerstone design my envelope for me?

Yes, design services are available as an add-on during checkout.

Do you also print union-labeled envelopes?

Yes — see our Union Envelope, a #10 envelope printed at a union shop for political and labor clients.

What's the minimum order quantity?

250 envelopes, with quantity breaks up to 25,000.
